questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to stay safe while cycling around the busy streets of London
Safety jackets becoming a fashion item
Why fashion from the 1980s is coming back
How workers choose their uniforms
questions.why: They discuss the high-vis jacket as 'the oddest item of clothing to hit the catwalk this year'.

questions.q: Why is Rob wearing a high-vis jacket?
options: He wants to look fashionable
He works in the road and has just come back from a job
He wears it for cycling and forgot to take it off
It was a present from Neil
questions.why: Rob says he wears it when cycling around London and just forgot to take it off.

questions.q: Who were high-vis jackets originally designed for?
options: People who need to be seen, like cyclists and road workers
Fashion models on the catwalk
Dancers and athletes
Police officers and people who direct traffic at big events
questions.why: Rob says they were designed for safety for cyclists, pedestrians and workers who need to be seen.

questions.q: According to Hannah Marriott, why are bright clothes popular now?
options: They are cheaper than other clothes
They are more comfortable
Designers have run out of ideas
They catch people's attention on social media
questions.why: She says people scroll Instagram at speed, so anything that catches the eye gets attention.

questions.q: What kind of fashion is getting less attention, according to Hannah Marriott?
options: Quiet, simple items like a cashmere jumper
Sportswear
Workwear
Expensive designer labels from famous fashion houses
questions.why: She says bright trends are getting more traction than 'the sort of understated cashmere jumper' fashion.

questions.q: What does Hannah Marriott say is a difficult issue with this trend?
options: The jackets are uncomfortable to wear
Fashion sells for £2000 what low-paid workers wear
The jackets are made cheaply and damage the environment
Designers copy each other
questions.why: She mentions charging £2000 for something similar to a uniform worn by someone who doesn't earn much.

questions.q: What safety problem does Rob mention?
options: Fashion jackets are not bright enough
Cyclists will stop wearing jackets
Drivers will be distracted by so many bright clothes on the street
People who need to be seen may not stand out
questions.why: Rob says if everyone wears high-vis, people who need to stand out for safety may not.

questions.q: Why does Rob mention Neil's old red jeans?
options: To say Neil should wear them again
To ask where Neil bought them
To joke that Neil was a fashion victim
To show that red is a safe colour
questions.why: He gives them as an example of a fashion victim wearing something that doesn't look good.
